WITNESS STATEMENT — Marcus Chen, Independent Supply-Chain Auditor (Exhibit C)

Sworn statement provided 2024-05-02 in Case No. CC-2024-0881

"I, Marcus Chen, Certified Supply Chain Auditor (CSCA #4421), hereby confirm:

1. I personally reviewed the export control notice FT-2024-EC-0291 issued by
   Fab-Taiwan on February 28, 2024. This notice is authentic and constitutes
   a government-mandated export restriction.

2. In my professional opinion, the supply disruption caused by FT-2024-EC-0291
   qualifies as a force majeure event under standard commercial contract terms,
   specifically consistent with the language in Section 9.3 of the WidgetCo/ACME
   Supply Agreement.

3. I have NOT seen any evidence that WidgetCo could have sourced alternative
   chip suppliers within the March 31, 2024 deadline at commercially
   reasonable cost. I reviewed three alternative supplier quotes obtained
   by WidgetCo; all quoted delivery timelines of 10–14 weeks.

Signed: Marcus Chen, CSCA #4421
Date: 2024-05-02"
